wl-69d203a8af1a.source: The clean plates are kept in the kitchen cabinet above the sink.
wl-69d203a8af1a.text: 清洁板保存在水槽上方的厨房柜子里.

wl-e52ec7a1e9dd.source: After borrowing heavily for university, he spent several years paying off the debt.
wl-e52ec7a1e9dd.text: 在为大学大量借款后,他花了几年时间还清债务.

wl-5cee1c23e160.source: The dean invited every member of the science faculty to attend the meeting.
wl-5cee1c23e160.text: 院长邀请所有科学系成员参加会议。

wl-14e833557d06.source: The conference hotel provides accommodation and meeting rooms in the same building.
wl-14e833557d06.text: 会议旅馆在同一座大楼提供住宿和会议室。

wl-8110c78c44ef.source: The witness described a man with dark hair and a thick moustache above his upper lip.
wl-8110c78c44ef.text: 目击者描述了一个头发深色,上唇上方有厚厚的胡子的人.

wl-36873307b7b0.source: The town's traditional potteries produce bowls and plates from local clay.
wl-36873307b7b0.text: 该镇的传统陶器用当地粘土生产碗和板.

wl-75c3f1e94b7f.source: The three roommates share responsibility for cleaning the kitchen and paying electricity bills.
wl-75c3f1e94b7f.text: 三个室友共同负责清理厨房和支付电费.

wl-4d82205a2028.source: We took a taxi from the airport directly to the hotel.
wl-4d82205a2028.text: 我们从机场直接坐出租车到酒店

wl-e6fb06210faf.source: Enter the six-digit code to unlock the building's front door.
wl-e6fb06210faf.text: 输入六位数代码以解锁大楼的前门.

wl-e97ba6aed556.source: The technician replaced the damaged cable connecting the monitor to the computer.
wl-e97ba6aed556.text: 技术员更换了连接显示器和计算机的受损电缆。

wl-964ec44ca8a4.source: The town's population has doubled over the past decade, from 2016 to 2026.
wl-964ec44ca8a4.text: 该市镇的人口在过去十年中翻了一番,从2016年到2026年.

wl-d68049bb8545.source: The engine failure forced the pilot to make an emergency landing.
wl-d68049bb8545.text: 发动机故障迫使飞行员紧急着陆.

wl-d1164167d55e.source: Call the emergency hotline if you notice smoke or fire in the building.
wl-d1164167d55e.text: 如果发现大楼内有烟雾或火灾,请拨紧急热线电话。

wl-87d17825792d.source: Open your mouth so the dentist can examine your teeth.
wl-87d17825792d.text: 张开嘴 让牙医检查你的牙齿

wl-b573f24e55d6.source: The storm cut electrical power to more than five thousand homes.
wl-b573f24e55d6.text: 风暴将电力切断至五千多户人家.

wl-fc166eb81361.source: Bus number twelve follows the fastest route from the campus to the station.
wl-fc166eb81361.text: 12号机车沿校区至车站最快路线行驶.

wl-75490f32c06a.source: The café serves black tea with milk or lemon.
wl-75490f32c06a.text: 咖啡馆为黑茶提供牛奶或柠檬.

wl-6c3dedbb6dc7.source: The museum accepted a generous donation of paintings from a local collector.
wl-6c3dedbb6dc7.text: 博物馆接受当地收藏家慷慨捐赠的画作.

wl-e382b1ded37d.source: Take an accurate measurement of the window before ordering new curtains.
wl-e382b1ded37d.text: 在订购新窗帘前精确测量窗户.

wl-e77a31599e99.source: The maximum number of students allowed in the laboratory is twenty-four.
wl-e77a31599e99.text: 实验室允许的学生人数最多为24人.

wl-984e18fe201c.source: We met for coffee at the small cafe opposite the library.
wl-984e18fe201c.text: 我们在图书馆对面的小咖啡馆碰面喝咖啡

wl-8501a34f34de.source: The committee will announce its final decision after reviewing every application.
wl-8501a34f34de.text: 委员会将在审查每项申请后宣布其最后决定。

wl-c590afa9bb59.source: A falcon can dive at extremely high speed when hunting smaller birds.
wl-c590afa9bb59.text: 猎鹰在捕捉较小的鸟类时可以极其高速地潜水.

wl-8c72b58e547c.source: Police began a nationwide hunt for the missing painting.
wl-8c72b58e547c.text: 警察开始在全国范围内追捕失踪的画作.

wl-94b19a105fce.source: The outdoor cinema shows a family movie every Friday evening.
wl-94b19a105fce.text: 户外电影院每周五晚间放映家庭电影.

wl-dace6f5c8fbc.source: The lecturer used powerpoint slides to display graphs and photographs.
wl-dace6f5c8fbc.text: 讲师使用动力点幻灯片来显示图表和照片.

wl-0f400122e37d.source: One important laboratory rule requires students to wear eye protection.
wl-0f400122e37d.text: 一个重要的实验室规则要求学生佩戴眼罩.

wl-4a82cb6db537.source: The language teacher corrected each student's pronunciation.
wl-4a82cb6db537.text: 语言老师纠正了每个学生的发音.

wl-801453075731.source: The technician gave a practical demonstration of how to operate the new equipment.
wl-801453075731.text: 技术员就如何操作新设备作了实际示范。

wl-90e0948a756a.source: Students can buy a hot lunch in the campus cafeteria between lectures.
wl-90e0948a756a.text: 学生可以在讲座之间购买校园食堂的热午餐.

wl-55f2754de6a8.source: The survey recorded a steady decline in bus use as more residents bought cars.
wl-55f2754de6a8.text: 调查显示,随着更多居民购买汽车,公交车使用量持续下降.

wl-2899441143e2.source: Switch on the ceiling fan if the classroom becomes too warm.
wl-2899441143e2.text: 如果教室变得太暖和,就把天花板的风扇打开.

wl-cae56215a804.source: Wildlife hunting is strictly forbidden inside the national park.
wl-cae56215a804.text: 国家公园内严禁猎捕野生动物.

wl-4b696327299c.source: Regular exercise strengthens each muscle used to support the lower back.
wl-4b696327299c.text: 定期锻炼可以加强用于支撑下背部的每个肌肉.

wl-261e0f6aeef3.source: As a safety precaution, all visitors must wear a helmet inside the factory.
wl-261e0f6aeef3.text: 作为安全防范措施,所有访客必须在工厂内佩戴头盔.

wl-40102dbf9080.source: The wildlife safari allows visitors to observe elephants from a safe vehicle.
wl-40102dbf9080.text: 野生猎物允许游客从安全车辆上观察大象.

wl-411b089d2971.source: The course combines classroom teaching with practical experience.
wl-411b089d2971.text: 该课程结合课堂教学和实践经验.

wl-895ff49d4e22.source: The injured bird remained in a cage until it was strong enough to fly.
wl-895ff49d4e22.text: 受伤的鸟只留在笼子里,直到它足够强大才能飞翔.

wl-0a374f3e650b.source: Colourful paper decorations were hung across the hall for the graduation party.
wl-0a374f3e650b.text: 彩色的纸张装饰被挂在大厅对面,用于毕业派对.

wl-c5675e962355.source: The standard bus fare is two pounds, but students travel for less.
wl-c5675e962355.text: 标准公交车票价为2磅,但学生出行费用较少.

wl-766250612b00.source: Her original idea was to turn the empty factory into an arts centre.
wl-766250612b00.text: 她最初的想法是把空工厂变成艺术中心.

wl-5019bac93989.source: The natural history museum displays dinosaur bones and rare fossils.
wl-5019bac93989.text: 自然历史博物馆展出恐龙骨骼和稀有化石.

wl-13800272d7a8.source: The components must be measured with great precision because even a small error matters.
wl-13800272d7a8.text: 必须非常精确地测量这些组件,因为即使是小错误都很重要。

wl-be6c324c05dd.source: All new employees attend a workplace safety course.
wl-be6c324c05dd.text: 所有新雇员都参加工作场所安全课程。

wl-d25187dc137f.source: A research team collected water samples from the river.
wl-d25187dc137f.text: 一个研究小组从河中采集水样.

wl-f52207dc9b3e.source: Factory workers receive discounted meals in the staff canteen.
wl-f52207dc9b3e.text: 工厂职工在职工食堂享受折扣膳食.

wl-15fe6865954b.source: She moved to Cambridge to study at one of its historic colleges.
wl-15fe6865954b.text: 她搬到剑桥,在剑桥的一个历史学院学习.

wl-ab464f025204.source: A signal failure caused a forty-minute delay to the morning train.
wl-ab464f025204.text: 信号故障导致早间列车延迟40分钟.

wl-36a3bbe0659d.source: The school group visited a dairy farm to see how milk is produced.
wl-36a3bbe0659d.text: 学校小组访问了一家乳品养殖场,看看牛奶是如何生产的。

wl-2b4a5042819e.source: Passengers must show photographic identification before boarding the international flight.
wl-2b4a5042819e.text: 乘客必须在登上国际航班前出示照片。

wl-3a01be17246d.source: Live music is performed in the hotel lounge on Saturday nights.
wl-3a01be17246d.text: 现场音乐于周六晚上在酒店休息室进行.

wl-281ad2a40c86.source: Students stated a clear preference for face-to-face classes over recorded lectures.
wl-281ad2a40c86.text: 学生们表示,他们明显倾向于面对面上课,而不是有记录的讲座。

wl-df8c165555a5.source: The boat will sail from the harbour at sunrise.
wl-df8c165555a5.text: 船会在日出时从港口启航.

wl-b656b1194b60.source: The guide avoided technical jargon so that non-specialists could understand.
wl-b656b1194b60.text: 该指南避免了技术术语,以便非专家能够理解。

wl-45b724982f78.source: In the desert, a camel can travel for days with very little water.
wl-45b724982f78.text: 在沙漠中,骆驼可以用很少的水行走几天.

wl-52934c29ca4a.source: Each participating country may send one delegate to vote at the conference.
wl-52934c29ca4a.text: 每一与会国可派一名代表出席会议投票。

wl-43cf2e256880.source: The local farmer grows wheat and keeps more than fifty sheep.
wl-43cf2e256880.text: 当地农民种植小麦,养羊五十余只.

wl-1db089a9f84e.source: The bank asks several security questions to confirm each customer's identity.
wl-1db089a9f84e.text: 银行会提出几个安全问题来确认每个客户的身份.

wl-fe0feb3c2360.source: The school musical combines acting, singing and dancing.
wl-fe0feb3c2360.text: 学校的音乐剧结合了表演,歌唱和舞蹈.

wl-e8b242ff17ff.source: In the phrase 'on campus', the word 'on' is a preposition.
wl-e8b242ff17ff.text: 在"校园上"这一短语中,"on"一词是一个预设词.

wl-a4bb44eb9667.source: Strong winds forced the club to cancel the afternoon sailing lesson.
wl-a4bb44eb9667.text: 强风迫使俱乐部取消了下午的航行课.

wl-2a4c3b84009d.source: The autumn term begins in September and ends before Christmas.
wl-2a4c3b84009d.text: 秋季学期开始于9月,结束于圣诞节之前.

wl-f8c702f0797b.source: Regular ferries carry passengers and vehicles between the mainland and the island.
wl-f8c702f0797b.text: 定期渡轮在大陆和岛屿之间运送乘客和车辆.

wl-251e382f7635.source: Visitors may bring a camera, but flash photography is not allowed inside the museum.
wl-251e382f7635.text: 参观者可能带相机,但不允许闪光摄影进入博物馆内部.

wl-2a17ce1476cc.source: To the children's delight, the zoo allowed them to feed the penguins.
wl-2a17ce1476cc.text: 为了孩子们的快乐,动物园允许他们喂养企鹅.

wl-c96529e4cb5d.source: Organic farming avoids artificial pesticides and fertilisers.
wl-c96529e4cb5d.text: 有机养殖可避免人工农药和化肥.

wl-0e7629279488.source: The satellite image shows the storm moving towards the coast.
wl-0e7629279488.text: 卫星图像显示风暴向海岸移动.

wl-2e417fcbfb17.source: A professional musician played the violin during the wedding ceremony.
wl-2e417fcbfb17.text: 一名专业音乐家在婚礼仪式上演奏小提琴.

wl-9fd01ae47722.source: The pharmacist cannot provide this medicine without a doctor's prescription.
wl-9fd01ae47722.text: 没有医生的处方药,药剂师就无法提供这种药物.

wl-f41c041baa45.source: The lunch menu includes soup, a fresh salad and a bread roll.
wl-f41c041baa45.text: 午餐菜单包括汤,新鲜沙拉和面包卷.

wl-30f7a16c51a3.source: New medical technology allows doctors to diagnose disease earlier.
wl-30f7a16c51a3.text: 新的医疗技术可以让医生更早诊断疾病.

wl-3345867ecfee.source: Repairing the damaged roof is the school's highest priority.
wl-3345867ecfee.text: 修复受损屋顶是学校的最高优先.

wl-fac37bc72e58.source: The hikers returned to their base camp before it became dark.
wl-fac37bc72e58.text: 徒步者在天黑前回到了他们的大本营.

wl-391cb1e07c5f.source: The furniture shop offers free delivery to addresses within ten kilometres.
wl-391cb1e07c5f.text: 家具店在10公里内免费提供地址。

wl-ed421c35417f.source: The exhibition shows how women's fashion changed during the twentieth century.
wl-ed421c35417f.text: 展览展示了20世纪女性时尚的变化.

wl-a9a581005e96.source: The study examines the impact of tourism on small island communities.
wl-a9a581005e96.text: 这项研究审查了旅游业对小岛屿社区的影响。

wl-c2640f79b4ed.source: The tired child took a short afternoon nap after lunch.
wl-c2640f79b4ed.text: 疲劳的孩子在午餐后短暂午睡.

wl-e4c8d951f1cc.source: Each student gives a ten-minute presentation on the results of the research project.
wl-e4c8d951f1cc.text: 每个学生就研究项目的结果作十分钟的介绍。

wl-e310f2ca5bd1.source: The café prepares several vegetarian salads with seasonal vegetables.
wl-e310f2ca5bd1.text: 咖啡馆用季节性蔬菜准备数种素食沙拉.

wl-a81fecb038e8.source: Brush your teeth twice a day to prevent decay.
wl-a81fecb038e8.text: 每天刷两次牙以防腐烂.

wl-f8abebc0e56a.source: The museum controls temperature and light to ensure the preservation of old documents.
wl-f8abebc0e56a.text: 博物馆控制温度和光线,以确保旧文件的保存.

wl-3930d9085fc7.source: The student accommodation is located on the northern side of the university campus.
wl-3930d9085fc7.text: 学生宿舍位于大学校园北侧.

wl-5b5fb1c9d703.source: This yoghurt is low in fat and contains no added sugar.
wl-5b5fb1c9d703.text: 这种酸奶脂脂肪含量低,不含加糖.

wl-649d69d4a033.source: The country increased food imports after drought reduced domestic production.
wl-649d69d4a033.text: 在干旱使国内生产减少之后,该国增加了粮食进口。

wl-a5197f10266a.source: The reserve allows visitors to observe birds and other wildlife in nature.
wl-a5197f10266a.text: 该保护区允许游客在自然界中观察鸟类和其他野生动物.

wl-47dfeb55d084.source: The advertised annual salary is thirty thousand pounds before tax.
wl-47dfeb55d084.text: 公布的年薪在纳税前为3万英镑。

wl-3b01d3ebd10b.source: Contact the booking office by telephone if you need to change your reservation.
wl-3b01d3ebd10b.text: 如果您需要更改预约,请联系预约办公室。

wl-266ec841a313.source: Each job candidate must complete an interview and a short written test.
wl-266ec841a313.text: 每个工作候选人必须完成面试和简短的书面考试。

wl-e0f937561436.source: You should make an appointment with a dentist if the toothache continues.
wl-e0f937561436.text: 如果牙痛持续,你应该和牙医预约.

wl-f37a74d82869.source: The village celebration ended with a huge feast shared by all the families.
wl-f37a74d82869.text: 村里的庆祝活动以所有家庭共享的盛宴结束.

wl-ecfaa9a2a27e.source: His inability to read small print indicated that he needed glasses.
wl-ecfaa9a2a27e.text: 他无法阅读小字报,说明他需要眼镜.

wl-203b5520e052.source: In British English, naught=nought represents the number zero.
wl-203b5520e052.text: 在英国英语中,无=noughd表示数字为0.

wl-3fd16b2770b0.source: The club president chairs meetings and represents members at university events.
wl-3fd16b2770b0.text: 俱乐部主席主持会议并代表会员参加大学活动.

wl-5b8a763b5451.source: The bookshop reduced all dictionaries by twenty percent during its summer sale.
wl-5b8a763b5451.text: 书店暑期发售时将所有字典减少20%.

wl-82f4516eee9d.source: The observatory's powerful telescope reveals distant planets and stars.
wl-82f4516eee9d.text: 该天文台强大的望远镜揭示了遥远的行星和恒星.

wl-7aa020f7ef6a.source: When the electricity failed, she lit a candle so that she could see.
wl-7aa020f7ef6a.text: 电力故障时,她点燃蜡烛,让她能看到.

wl-eb3c62690ec9.source: All passport applications are processed by a separate government department.
wl-eb3c62690ec9.text: 所有护照申请均由单独的政府部门处理。

wl-85f15bc57d6c.source: The biologist identified the bird from a single blue feather.
wl-85f15bc57d6c.text: 生物学家从单一的蓝色羽毛中辨认出这只鸟.

wl-2ff8dd800e03.source: Reception staff answer all incoming calls and direct them to the correct department.
wl-2ff8dd800e03.text: 接待人员接听所有接收到的电话,并指示他们到正确的部门.

wl-bb4a91749fe0.source: Adjust the office chair to avoid pain in your shoulders and neck.
wl-bb4a91749fe0.text: 调整办公室椅,避免肩膀和脖子疼痛.

wl-94509ddf85cc.source: Regular handwashing plays an important role in disease prevention.
wl-94509ddf85cc.text: 定期洗手在疾病预防中起到重要作用.

wl-b295d117135a.source: The doctor advised him to reduce the amount of salt in his diet.
wl-b295d117135a.text: 医生建议他减少饮食中的盐量.

wl-60085763fb0f.source: The documentary will be shown on national television tonight.
wl-60085763fb0f.text: 纪录片今晚将在国家电视台播放。

wl-1ffb8796edd9.source: Tenants must pay a refundable deposit before moving into the flat.
wl-1ffb8796edd9.text: 租户在迁入公寓前必须交纳应退还的押金.

wl-4b7615dce52c.source: A useful feature of the new app is its offline map.
wl-4b7615dce52c.text: 新app的一个有用的特点是它的离线地图.

wl-e540cdd1328b.source: Use the alphabetical index at the back of the book to find a particular topic.
wl-e540cdd1328b.text: 使用书尾的字母索引来查找特定话题.

wl-391b6629d9b6.source: The fisherman repaired a hole in his net before returning to sea.
wl-391b6629d9b6.text: 渔夫在返海前修了网洞.

wl-2cd070a4fc87.source: Students receive a monthly allowance for library printing.
wl-2cd070a4fc87.text: 学生每月领取图书馆印刷津贴。

wl-8151325dcdba.source: The nurse sent a blood sample to the laboratory for testing.
wl-8151325dcdba.text: 护士将血液样本送往实验室进行检测.

wl-fbd46c2953f2.source: He lost his temper when the flight was cancelled for a third time.
wl-fbd46c2953f2.text: 当航班第三次取消时,他失去了脾气.

wl-338526e5c661.source: The entrance fees help pay for wildlife conservation in the national park.
wl-338526e5c661.text: 入园费帮助支付国家公园野生动物保护费用.

wl-5d8df9b1deff.source: Canberra, rather than Sydney, is the capital of Australia.
wl-5d8df9b1deff.text: 堪培拉而不是悉尼是澳大利亚的首都.

wl-f82a8e8dd311.source: The research team measured the depth of the lake at several different points.
wl-f82a8e8dd311.text: 研究小组在几个不同的点测量了湖的深度.

wl-ef15f48c9654.source: Students receive written feedback explaining how to improve their essays.
wl-ef15f48c9654.text: 学生收到书面反馈,解释如何改进他们的论文。

wl-1984337fca8f.source: The automobile industry employs thousands of workers in the region.
wl-1984337fca8f.text: 汽车工业在该地区雇用了数千名工人。

wl-29cf0a63a0aa.source: The local newspaper publishes community news every Thursday.
wl-29cf0a63a0aa.text: 当地报纸每周四发布社区新闻.

wl-5e8aa2016450.source: She lost one sandal while walking along the beach.
wl-5e8aa2016450.text: 在沙滩上散步时她失去了一只凉鞋.
